lucee.notes:
Since Lucee 6, this function iterates over each character in the string.

For list-based iteration with delimiters, use [[function-listreduce]] instead.

[LDEV-3747](https://luceeserver.atlassian.net/browse/LDEV-3747)

name: StringReduce
description: Iterates over every element of the string and calls the closure to work on the elements of the string. This function will reduce the string to a single value and will return the value.
syntax: StringReduce( string string, function closure, [any initialVal] )

params.name: closure
params.description: Closure or a function reference that will be called for each of the iteration.

params.name: initialVal
params.description: Initial value that will be used for the reduce operation.
